💧 Ofwat has just provisionally approved £3.39 BILLION of extra funding that 13 water companies asked for — outside the normal price review process.

💸 Customers of five suppliers face annual bills up to £43 higher between 2027 and 2030. That's after a 27% rise in 2025-26 and another 5.4% this year.

🔧 £1.2bn of it is to "safeguard existing assets" — billions to stop pipes you already paid for from falling apart.

⏳ And the consultation closes at 5pm on 24 September. Had anyone told you?

A regulator that keeps approving what the companies ask for isn't a regulator. It's a rubber stamp. 👇
